label: Nexcomm HaLoW — leak / flow / total (6 ch)
notes: MQTT driver (read-only). HaLoW gateway publishes JSON to nexcomm/halow/<deviceId>/telemetry. Six channels CH1–CH6: leak (BOOL), flow_gpm (REAL), total_gal (REAL). Set broker URL and deviceId when applying. Sample: st/fixtures/halow-telemetry-sample.json.
